decision: Check gzip level 1 correctness/storage tradeoff against raw TEXT, gzip level 6 and Brotli quality 4 without claiming CPU/RAM superiority.
factors: SQLite UTF-8, UTF-16le, UTF-16be storage encoding
criteria: Every candidate losslessly round-trips identical UTF8 JSON bytes.
The implemented tagged representation decodes to each exact original receipt.
Actual SQLite octet_length for implemented storage is no greater than raw TEXT for each case and encoding.
stoppingCondition: Run once after source/test checks; fix correctness failures before accepting. No timing ranking, representative-user ratio, old 66-sample reproduction, browser or sustained acceptance is claimed.
